fields.System.Title: INB-303 — Confirm a putaway and move the stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want to confirm that I have put stock away, so that the
system knows where it is and it becomes available to sell.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a task assigned to me, when I scan the destination and confirm the quantity,
  • then stock moves from receiving to that location, a movement is written, and the task
  • closes — all in one transaction.
  • - Given a task assigned to someone else, then my confirmation is rejected.
  • - Given a destination that fails validation at scan time, then the confirm is rejected
  • and an alternative is suggested.
  • - Given a confirmed quantity less than the task quantity, then the remainder stays on
  • the task — see [INB-308](INB-308-split-putaway.md).
  • - Given the same confirm sent twice with one idempotency key, then the stock moves once.
  • - Given the confirm, then the stock becomes available for allocation.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Two operators on one task ([doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate confirm ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency · idempotency · rollback |
